feature: Automatic Sweep1 stations, traversal, full-rail anchoring and viewport selection

straight_surfaces.scope: Exact normalized correspondence bounds on both complete rational U boundaries; equal positive weight rows make V affine and extend the bound to the entire tensor surface. Ordered selection, RailName and RailId are exercised.

curved_samples.scope: Numerical closest-point comparisons do not certify complete curved surfaces or prove inequality when they disagree. The known sampled discrepancy is independently bounded against the existing explicit-station model.

extent_checks.scope: Two U endpoints of the rail-side surface boundary, including both spatial Greville anchors and the direction split between parameters 0.51 and 0.55. Surface interiors are not qualified by these endpoint checks.
extent_checks.excluded_investigation: arc-thirty: native refit endpoint/clock discrepancy; raw capture retained without an agreement claim.

query_contract.native_producer: SMLib GlobalCurveSolve(SM_SO_MINIMIZE), followed by exact source hull certification; no directed maxima are computed.

remaining: The measured spatial sweep or closest-point discrepancy
